verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents a public programmatic API: the Python AsyncWebCrawler.arun() interface has code examples in the official docs. It also ships a Dockerized FastAPI server with an interactive playground that generates request code, plus a documented CLI and an official MCP server for agent-driven use. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404, and no llms.txt), no REST endpoint reference in the evidence, and no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the HTTP API.
